title: Don't let AI replace you. Make it work for you.
armature: AI will take some jobs, but it also lets one person do what used to take a whole team: the next big company can start with one person and a team of AI agents.

scenes.title: Don't let AI replace you.
scenes.narration: Don't let AI replace you. Make it work for you.

scenes.title: A business idea. No team. No budget.
scenes.narration: Have a business idea, but no team? No big budget?

scenes.title: That might not stop you anymore.
scenes.narration: That might not stop you anymore.

scenes.title: A website. An app.

scenes.title: Some tasks. Some jobs.

scenes.title: A new generation of business owners
scenes.narration: But it could also create a new generation of business owners.

scenes.title: Once: an entire team. Now: one.
scenes.narration: People who once needed an entire team just to get started.

scenes.title: The future isn't only about what AI can do.
scenes.narration: Because the future isn't only about what AI can do.

scenes.title: It's about what you can build with it.
scenes.narration: It's about what you can build with it.

scenes.title: One person…
scenes.narration: The next big company might start with one person…

scenes.title: …and a team of AI agents.
scenes.narration: And a team of AI agents.
